quote: The new fail-closed recovery path can prevent Codex stdio startup when process inspection or bounded cleanup is unavailable; that is intentional, but requires maintainer acceptance for existing POSIX deployments.
note: The P1 item under Before merge warns that unavailable process inspection blocks Codex stdio startup, and the earlier review identifies the required post-spawn `ps` snapshot that the macOS sandbox denied.
